name: Full built-in lesson notes and learner progress
description: A JSS1 learner reads a substantive lesson and saves progress.
steps: Select Nigerian, Revised curriculum, Junior secondary and Year 7
Open Subjects and Mathematics using Open Mathematics
Verify 30 class topics, search for Fractions: equivalent fractions and addition and open it
Verify Learning objectives, Key terms, five explanatory teaching sections, Worked examples, Lesson summary and Practice questions
Open Show model answer for a practice question
Mark as read and Save bookmark
Answer the three checkpoint questions with 3/4, 4/6 and 1/2, then Check answers
Close subject and open Progress, refresh and verify the lesson is read with best score 100%
Open Bookmarks and Read notes, then close, Remove the full-notes bookmark and refresh
expected: The substantive fraction notes teach the method and show worked solutions; the checkpoint score is 100%. Read status and score persist. The bookmark persists until removed and stays removed after refresh.

name: Distinct class plans and curriculum subject boundaries
description: Classes get distinct plans and retain their subject boundaries.
steps: Select Nigerian, Revised curriculum, Junior secondary, Year 8
Open Mathematics and verify 30 topics including Percentage increase and decrease
Filter Term 2 then search zzzmissing and clear topic filters
Close subject and select Year 9; open Mathematics and verify Simultaneous linear equations and Linear inequalities
Close subject, search Chemistry and verify no junior subject results
Clear filters, choose Senior secondary, Year 10 and Science category; verify Chemistry is available
Refresh and verify Year 10 and Nigerian persist
expected: JSS2 and JSS3 show different detailed topic sets. Topic search has a useful empty state and clearing restores results. Junior excludes standalone Chemistry, senior includes it, and preferences persist.

name: Generated lesson notes for a Nigerian subject
description: A non-seeded subject provides real teaching notes rather than a placeholder.
steps: Select Nigerian, Revised curriculum, Junior secondary and Year 7
Open Business Studies and wait for the detailed class plan
Verify at least 30 distinct topic entries and suggested term groups
Open the first topic and wait while the four lesson sections prepare
Verify that no AI attribution is displayed and that explanatory sections, two worked examples, a summary, practice questions with model answers and at least three checkpoint questions are present
Click Check answers without answering every checkpoint question
Verify validation, Close subject, refresh and reopen the same topic
expected: Full notes contain substantive Business Studies teaching with explanations and examples, not just instructions to consult a textbook. Unanswered checkpoint submission is blocked. The same saved plan and notes return after reload. The completed notes are saved and reopen without generating the entire lesson again.

name: Class-plan failure and retry
description: A topic-service failure gives a useful message and a retry.

body_json.error: The topic plan service is temporarily unavailable.

steps: Select Nigerian, Junior secondary, Year 7 and open Intermediate Science
Verify the class topic plan failure message
Use Retry topic plan
expected: The failure is visible with Retry topic plan. Retrying either loads a plan if service recovers or retains a clear failure message; it never shows fabricated topics or clears saved progress.

name: Lesson-note failure and retry
description: A failed note request is recoverable without pretending notes exist.

body_json.error: The lesson service is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.

steps: Select Nigerian, Revised curriculum, Junior secondary, Year 9 and open Mathematics
Open Linear inequalities, a topic not used in another test
Verify the lesson-service failure message and Retry lesson notes
Use Retry lesson notes and then All topics
Close subject, select British and verify KS3 or the appropriate current British subject set remains available
expected: The actual lesson-service failure is visible with Retry lesson notes. No completion or quiz controls appear for unavailable notes, and All topics remains usable. Retrying reuses successful saved sections when available; British subject selection remains usable.
